title: Nkonimdifo a Ɔwɔ Nneɛma Abien Ntam
intro: Wɔ ɔsoro akwankyerɛ ho abakɔsɛm mu no, onipa biako gyina hɔ sɛ sodifo tumidifo ne Allah akoa a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase. Saa onipa yi tuu kwan kɔɔ asase so akyirikyiri, na ohui sɛ owia puei wɔ nnipa a wɔyɛ soronko so na ɛkɔtɔe wɔ asubura tuntum bi a ɛyɛ kusuu mu. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara no, wɔde adwuma hyɛɛ akoa yi nsa sɛ ɔnsi akwanside soronko bi ntia ɔman a wɔyɛ basabasa kɛse. So wubetumi ahu saa anansesɛm mu nipa yi afi Kur’aan mu?
clues: Mmɔborohunufo no maa me tumi ne nkɛntɛnso wɔ asase so
Mituu kwan kɔɔ baabi a owia pue ne baabi a ɛkɔtɔ
Miduu nnipa bi a na ɛkame ayɛ sɛ wontumi nte asɛmfua biako ase nkyɛn
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ memfa dade nsi akwanside kɛse bi
Mede dade a wɔabɔ no kataa mmepɔw abien a ɛso yɛ toro ntam
Na mennye ɔbɔfoɔ anaa ɔkɔmhyɛni, na mmom na meyɛ akoa a Allah de adom maa no

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
